content.short: PolyFlow is a PayFi protocol linking real-world payments and assets to DeFi.
content.description: PolyFlow builds PayFi (payment finance) infrastructure that combines payment functions with financial services on-chain, such as collateralising stablecoins for loans, linking real-world asset flows to DeFi. Stable's official ecosystem page lists PolyFlow.
content.meta: PolyFlow is a PayFi protocol linking real-world payments to DeFi, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
